daily.today_energy: Your mind is sparkling with creative possibilities today, Gemini. Channel that restless energy into something meaningful—whether it's a conversation that matters or a project you've been procrastinating on. The vibe is productive but playful.
daily.love: There's potential for deeper connection if you actually listen instead of planning your next comeback. Your person (or potential person) needs to feel seen right now. Lead with curiosity, not cleverness. That's where the magic lives.
daily.career: Your communication skills are at peak performance—this is your moment to speak up in meetings or reach out to someone you've been meaning to connect with. Trust that your ideas have value. The universe is amplifying your voice today.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and fresh air. Even a 15-minute walk can shift your whole energy. Don't overthink the wellness routine—just do something that feels good. Your nervous system will thank you.

weekly.overview: Mercury's doing its thing this week, Gem. You're in your communication era—expect conversations to hit different. The vibe is all about showing up authentically rather than performing. Lean into the nervous energy; it's actually your superpower right now.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or single, there's a softness moving through your romantic sphere. If you've been holding back saying something real, this is your moment. Vulnerability hits harder than any game could ever. Pay attention to who's actually listening.
weekly.career: Projects you've been sitting on are ready to move. The energy supports bold moves and fresh takes on old problems. Don't wait for permission—your instincts are sharper than usual. Collaboration flows naturally if you lead with curiosity instead of ego.
weekly.health: Your nervous system's asking for more grounding this week. Think less intense workouts, more intentional rest. Your body's signaling that consistency matters more than intensity right now. Listen to what actually feels good, not what you think should feel good.
